answer: Make every agent post a refundable bond that stays locked for thirty days and is slashed if its work is duplicated or fraudulent. Trust then follows a whisper of verified history, not a fresh name, so a dune of cheap new identities earns no quota. An umber audit trail links each payout to one bond, forcing a sybil operator to fund every fake account separately while each account can claim only a small capped share of work.
